items.claim: Aspen lands a high volume of strikes at a high clip, especially to the body.
items.quote: throwing that high volume and landing at a pretty high clip, especially to the body.

items.claim: Training with Thomas Peterson every day improves Aspen's takedown defense.
items.quote: if you're training with Thomas Peterson every day, your takedown defense is going to get better.

items.claim: Aspen will out-box Pat on the feet if the fight stays standing.
items.quote: Espin's just going to box him up.

items.claim: Ty Miller will knock out Billy Goff.
items.quote: I think Ty Miller knocks him out.

items.claim: Ty Miller does not traditionally possess a high amount of finishing power.
items.quote: he doesn't really have that much power necessarily.

items.claim: Billy Goff has poor defensive skills.
Billy Goff has been inactive and inconsistent in the UFC.
items.quote: he's just been inactive. He's been a little bit inconsistent.

items.claim: Ty Miller has a reach and height advantage over Billy Goff.
items.quote: you look at this fight and you see Tai Miller's reach advantage. You see that tight height advantage

items.claim: Billy Goff does not have great defense against straight punches.
items.quote: against someone that doesn't really have great defense. Miller throws a lot of straight punches... I don't think Kov's going to be able to counter it.
